orgProfile.name: Corner Print Shop (fictional)
orgProfile.description: A small print and copy shop. Used only for tests and as a format example.
orgProfile.backups: A USB drive, rotated weekly and kept off-site.

ransomNote.text: Your files are encrypted. This is a sample note for testing.

backupsIntact.label: The off-site USB backup was not connected and is intact

preparation.measure: Keep an offline backup and test restoring it
preparation.detail: An offline copy cannot be encrypted by malware on the network.

start.title: The order system won't open

inbox.body: Every file on the server ends in .lock now. There's a note.

start.narrative: A ransom note is on the shared drive. The shop opens in eighteen minutes.

choices.label: Unplug the server and the counter PCs from the network
choices.hint: Stops the spread. Orders are on paper today.

debrief.whyItMatters: Isolation limits how far the ransomware spreads.
debrief.betterPractice: Isolate affected systems first, then investigate.

choices.label: Keep taking orders while you look into it

debrief.whyItMatters: Encryption keeps spreading while systems stay connected.

scope.title: What do we still have?
scope.narrative: You need to know whether you can restore.

choices.label: Check the off-site USB backup
choices.hint: Takes an hour to fetch it.

debrief.whyItMatters: Knowing your backup status decides every later option.

choices.label: Assume the backups are gone and go straight to options

backups_good.title: The backup is clean
backups_good.narrative: The USB drive has last week's files.

choices.label: Wipe and restore from the backup
choices.hint: Lose a few days of orders.

debrief.whyItMatters: Restoring from a clean backup avoids paying.

backups_bad.title: No backup in hand
backups_bad.narrative: Without a backup the options narrow.

debrief.whyItMatters: Payment carries sanctions risk and no guarantee.

end_restore.title: Back in business
end_restore.summary: You recovered from your own backups.

end_pay.title: Paid and waiting
end_pay.narrative: The decryptor arrives and works on most files.
end_pay.summary: You paid, and recovered most files.

message.body: The laptop at the counter just got the note too.
